title: Schedule Note — Late-Charge Percentage Reduced for Larger Unpaid Installments, Equipment & Vehicle Loans
content:
**Note to the schedule.** On an Equipment & Vehicle Loans installment charged late, the late-charge percentage is lowered according to the unpaid part of the installment: by 1.0 point when the unpaid part is 5000.00 or more, by 0.5 point when it is at least 1500.00 but less than 5000.00, and not at all when it is less than 1500.00. The lowered percentage is applied to the unpaid part.

## The unpaid part

The unpaid part is the installment due less the interest and principal payments applied to that installment bill, with the most recent interest payment and the most recent principal payment on that bill added back when the member's bank returned them, all as they stand on the day the charge is booked.

## Reduction by band

| Unpaid part of the installment (USD) | Points taken off the late-charge percentage |
|---|---|
| 5000.00 or more | 1.0 |
| at least 1500.00 but less than 5000.00 | 0.5 |
| less than 1500.00 | none |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical unpaid parts)

| Unpaid part | Band | Points off |
|---|---|---|
| 4999.99 | at least 1500.00 but less than 5000.00 | 0.5 |
| 5000.00 | 5000.00 or more | 1.0 |
| 1499.99 | less than 1500.00 | none |
| 1500.00 | at least 1500.00 but less than 5000.00 | 0.5 |

## Hypothetical illustration

An unpaid part of 6000.00 on a loan whose late-charge percentage is 5: the percentage is lowered by 1.0 point to 4, and 4 percent of 6000.00 is 240.00.
